blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo formar condicionais mistas (If I had studied…, I would be… now) e usar o verbo transform.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Mixed Conditionals: Past Cause → Present Result
items: If + past perfect → would + base: **If I had studied** medicine, **I would be** a doctor now.
If + past simple → would have + pp: **If I were** more careful, **I wouldn’t have made** that mistake.
A: past event, present effect. B: permanent state, past effect.
**If the factory had not closed**, the town **would still be** thriving.
**If she were** less shy, she **would have spoken** up.

items.q: Type A links a past cause to a present result.
In Type B, the condition refers to a past event only.
Mixed conditionals link two different times.

head: Tipo
Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: If I **had studied** medicine, I **would be** a doctor.
If I **were** careful, I **wouldn’t have made** that mistake.
If the factory **hadn’t closed**, the town **would still be** thriving.
could / might no lugar de would

blocks.body: Pergunte: a **condição** é passada (→ past perfect) ou permanente/presente (→ past simple)? E o **resultado** é agora (→ would + base) ou foi no passado (→ would have + pp)?
Não use *would* na oração com *if*: ✗ *If I would have studied.*

items.s: If I ___ studied medicine, I would be a doctor now. (have)
If I ___ more careful, I wouldn’t have made that mistake. (be)
If the factory hadn’t closed, the town would still ___ thriving. (be)
If she were less shy, she would ___ spoken up. (have)

body: **If only I had known…** — Se ao menos eu soubesse…
**Hindsight is 20/20.** — Depois do fato, tudo é claro.
**Water under the bridge** — Águas passadas
**Cry over spilt milk** — Chorar pelo leite derramado
**The road not taken** — O caminho não percorrido
**Turn back the clock** — Voltar o relógio
**Make a world of difference** — Fazer toda a diferença
**For better or worse** — Para o bem ou para o mal
**Do you regret it?** — Você se arrepende?
**So the decision transformed your life.** — Então a decisão transformou sua vida.
**If I had taken that job, I would be in Berlin now.** — Se eu tivesse aceitado aquele emprego, estaria em Berlim agora.

blocks.task: Write 6 sentences with mixed conditionals (3 of type A and 3 of type B).
blocks.model: If I had saved more, I would be on holiday now. If we had moved, we would live by the sea. If the bank hadn’t failed, they would still own the shop. If I were more patient, I would have waited. If she were braver, she would have asked. If he were taller, he would have joined the team.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
